content.short: Shift Crypto is a Swiss-based security company providing high-security hardware wallets for Cardano ADA.
content.description: Shift Crypto AG is a leading Swiss security firm known for the BitBox02, a hardware wallet designed to provide robust protection for digital assets. For the Cardano community, the BitBox02 Multi-edition offers native support for ADA, enabling users to send, receive, and stake their tokens with ease. Featuring a unique dual-chip architecture and a fully open-source codebase, Shift Crypto ensures that users maintain full control over their private keys. The platform prioritizes both high-level security and user-friendly design to protect digital wealth in a decentralized world.
content.meta: Shift Crypto offers the secure BitBox02 hardware wallet for managing and staking Cardano ADA. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
